sermon.title: Injustice: Start to Finish—February 13, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: God says let justice run down like water. Children face injustice from the womb through home, school and culture, while government advocates for adult behavior. God’s pattern is marriage and family; do justly, love mercy and stand for His law.
